keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Delay in match because of an injury Raphael Obermair (Paderborn).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paderborn 0, Eintracht Frankfurt 1. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Farès Chaïbi.
